note: Prompts a real user would type. Running these needs a reachable instance — either real credentials or the stub server pattern used in scripts/lib/client.test.ts. Assertions describe what the run should demonstrate, not exact output text.

evals.prompt: how many tickets are still open in NEO right now, and what are the oldest three?
evals.expected_output: A count and three issues, obtained without silently truncating the result set.
assertions: Runs `config check` before making any product call
Uses `jira search --count` (or `--all`) rather than reporting the length of a single default page as the total
If the instance is Cloud, describes the count as approximate rather than exact
Orders by created ascending in JQL rather than sorting a partial page in its head

evals.prompt: file a bug in NEO: the /export endpoint returns 500s under burst traffic, we saw it on the 28th. assign it to me and put it in the current sprint
evals.expected_output: A created issue with a markdown description, assigned to the authenticated user.
assertions: Runs `jira meta NEO` (or `jira fields`) to learn the accepted issue types and required fields before creating
Passes the description via --description-file rather than embedding a long quoted string
Uses --assignee me instead of hardcoding an accountId
Shows the user what it is about to create, or reports the created key and URL afterwards
Does not invent a custom field id it has not looked up

evals.prompt: add a rollback section to the export runbook page on confluence — https://acme.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/NEO/pages/98765/Export+runbook
evals.expected_output: The page gains a rollback section with its existing content intact.
assertions: Uses `confluence append`, or reads the page first and passes --expect-version on update
Never sends an update body reconstructed from memory of the page
Passes markdown and lets the CLI convert, rather than hand-writing storage XHTML
Reports the resulting version number or URL

evals.prompt: set up jira for me — we're on jira.mashreqbank.local, self-hosted. my personal access token is in 1password under 'Mashreq Jira PAT'
evals.expected_output: A working global config using a 1password credential reference, verified with a real call.
assertions: Writes the config to ~/.agents/skill-config/atlassian/config.json (global layer)
Stores a { source: '1password', ref: 'op://...' } reference, never the token value
Infers or sets deployment 'server' and bearer auth for a non-atlassian.net host, and does not ask for an account email
Recognises that Confluence on a self-hosted instance needs its own baseUrl, and asks rather than guessing one
Finishes by running `config check` and reporting the authenticated identity

evals.prompt: NEO-12 shipped in 2.4.1, close it out and note that in the ticket
evals.expected_output: The issue transitioned to a closed status with a comment recording the version.
assertions: Lists available transitions before attempting one, rather than guessing a status name
Uses the transition whose destination is the closed status, even when the transition itself is named differently
Attaches the note as a comment (via --comment or `jira comment`) rather than editing the description
Does not delete or otherwise modify the issue beyond what was asked

evals.prompt: we work on two things here — neochain (jira NEO and NEOINF, wiki space NEO) and adi (the ADI project). set that up so I stop repeating myself
evals.expected_output: A scopes block in the config with both streams, a chosen default, and the pairing confirmed with the user.
assertions: Runs `jira projects` and `confluence spaces` to check the keys against what actually exists rather than taking them on faith
Writes a `scopes` map with jira.projects and confluence.space per stream, plus `defaultScope`
Asks the user which stream should be the default instead of picking silently
Confirms the resulting config with `config scopes`
Does not put a Jira project key in the confluence.space field without checking the space exists

evals.prompt: what's open across everything right now — all projects, not just neochain
evals.expected_output: An unscoped search, explicitly covering every project.
assertions: Passes --no-scope so the configured default scope does not narrow the result
Also passes --all or --count rather than reporting a single page as the whole picture
Does not silently return only the default scope's projects

evals.prompt: what did dana say about the gateway config on NEO-1?
evals.expected_output: The relevant comment, attributed, in readable text.
assertions: Fetches comments (`jira get --comments` or `jira comments`)
Reads the ADF comment body as text rather than dumping raw JSON at the user
Attributes the quote to the comment author and does not paraphrase it as fact if the wording matters
Makes no write calls
